item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 1:00 PM, 22 August 2026(Saturday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Zambales, Metro Manila(Quezon City, Caloocan, Navotas, Valenzuela, Malabon), Bataan(Bagac, Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Morong, Orani, Samal, Balanga, Abucay), Pampanga(Masantol, Macabebe, Sasmuan, Lubao, Floridablanca, Porac, Mabalacat, Angeles, Candaba), Tarlac(Concepcion, Tarlac City, San Jose, Bamban, Capas, Mayantoc, San Clemente, Camiling, Santa Ignacia), Quezon(Tayabas, Lucena, Pagbilao, Padre Burgos, Atimonan, Sariaya) and Rizal(Rodriguez) within the next 2-3 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in Bulacan(Bulakan, Obando, Meycauayan, Bocaue, Marilao) which may persist within 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
